## 1. Purpose

The cheap repair after doc 556 is:

```text
the law is mediator-generated and operation-stable for one presentation, but
it changes under admissible refinements or exists only as cover-local probe
data with nontrivial overlap error.
```

That repair still fails to find the missing object. A categorical source
square cannot depend on the presentation of its mediator. The generated law
has to be invariant under admissible source-square refinements and descend
from probe-local data without retuning, overlap mismatch, or a nonzero
descent cocycle.

The admissible source-square category is accepted only if its doc-556
mediator-generated composition-stable joint source-law is invariant under
admissible source-square refinements and descends across probe covers using

Thus presentation-dependent mediator laws, refinement-retuned laws,
cover-local-only laws, overlap mismatch, Cech cocycle failure,

## 3. Consequence

Doc 557 does not solve R1 and does not prove RH. It removes the
presentation-dependence escape from the categorical plan. The missing object
now has to be a mediator-generated source law which is not just locally
defined or presentation-stable, but genuinely descends along admissible
refinements.

The next negative route is sharper: prove that every mediator-generated
composition-stable joint law is presentation-dependent, refinement-retuned,
cover-local only, has overlap mismatch or a nonzero Cech cocycle, or loses
the DD.4 payload, handoff, graph, composition, or control data under
refinement.
